note: Authoritative scan bindings for the frontend. The workbook Scene_Anchors are placeholders (placeholder_until_valmet_scene_received), so a tag is placed only on an object whose class was confirmed by projecting its box into the COLMAP-posed video frames (data/derived/diagnostics/bindings_sheet.jpg). Which physical unit carries which tag is not printed on the hardware. hosted_assets are sensors simulated on that object; they take the host's position and draw no box of their own. Every other workbook row is not located in this scan. Baked procedural bindings in scene_objects.json are ignored. An entry with annotation and no asset_id is a scan label for something the workbook does not list; pin_label keeps its tag on screen. An entry whose object_id is not in scene_objects.json is drawn from its own obb.
